llm_response.reason: The site mimics the official Pokémon Center brand and design but uses the non-standard domain 'pokemoncenter.co.it,' which is not affiliated with official Pokémon Center shops (all use 'pokemoncenter.com'). The domain was registered extremely recently (June 30, 2025) with all ownership details hidden—a common trait among scam sites. The .co.it TLD is unusual and not associated with legitimate Pokémon Center operations. This, together with brand impersonation and lack of transparency, matches multiple scam characteristics, particularly of fake online stores that mimic well-known companies.
